reason: A DeepSeek Harness skill for generating project documentation, API references, changelogs, and inline JSDoc comments from repository and git information.

summaries.zh: 一个为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的文档生成插件，可根据项目结构、代码签名和 Git 历史生成 README、API 文档、变更日志及 JSDoc 注释。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that generates READMEs, API documentation, changelogs, and JSDoc comments from project structure, code signatures, and Git history.

capabilities: Generates README files from project structure
Generates API documentation from code signatures
Adds inline JSDoc comments to exported functions
